title: An examination of the quinic acid utilization genes in Aspergillus niger reveals the involvement of 2 pH-dependent permeases.
mechanism: A.niger same three enzyme route; clustered pH6.5 permease and second off-cluster pH3.5 permease.
current_impact: Does not contradict scoped N.crassa/A.nidulans statements; exclude universal single-cluster/single-permease/low-pH-passive-diffusion language.
continuation: Fulltext and exact A.niger gene/strain authorities before organism-specific graph expansion; not separate next-pathway candidate.
